gaps.title: Autonomous DDIL edge PED node with sensor-to-map exploitation (georegistered drone video, minute-scale 3D and change overlays without reach-back) and resilient reconciliation to AIDP/Maven
gaps.problem: Tactical intelligence nodes cannot process, exploit and locally fuse organic sensor data for 72+ hours while disconnected and then reconcile cleanly with enterprise platforms when links return, and small units cannot turn drone video into georegistered overlays, 3D models and change alerts on their TAK map without cloud reach-back or a GEOINT cell.
gaps.user: Brigade/battalion S2 sections, MDTF and SOF intelligence teams, platoon/company drone operators, company intelligence support teams, brigade geospatial cells

gaps.title: Third-party C2 app assurance and onboarding pipeline (continuous security assessment, RBAC/audit-logging conformance, SBOM, accreditation-as-code) for NGC2, TAK, Overmatch Armory and the Jailbreak API marketplace
gaps.problem: The Army wants an open app ecosystem but its flagship prototype hosted third-party apps that had never been assessed (25-200+ vulnerabilities each) with no RBAC or user-activity logging, and every ecosystem re-invents onboarding checks by hand, so getting an app and its models onto an accredited edge platform still requires bespoke hardening and evidence per app.
gaps.user: NGC2 team-lead integration engineers, TAK Product Center third-party pipeline operators, Overmatch Software Armory staff, Army authorizing officials and program-office ISSMs, small vendors seeking app acceptance

gaps.title: Authorization-evidence automation for SWFT, CSRMC, FedRAMP 20x and Zero Trust target-level (turning pipeline artifacts, SBOMs and control inheritance into AO-acceptable, reciprocally reusable packages)
gaps.problem: Programs and ISVs still assemble ATO and zero-trust evidence by hand into eMASS/Xacta while DoD shifts to SBOM-, assessment- and continuous-monitoring-based authorization (SWFT, CSRMC), programs must prove 91 ZT target activities by 30 Sep 2027, and FedRAMP moves to 20x, with no widely adopted tool turning pipeline artifacts into packages AOs accept and reuse.
gaps.user: ISSM/ISSO and authorizing-official staff, software-factory compliance leads, program ZT leads, DoD CIO ZT PfMO assessors, ISV compliance engineers

gaps.title: Auditable day-2 operations and model lifecycle for fleets of DDIL edge clusters (image, model, certificate and policy updates; validate, distribute, roll back and prove what ran where; low-signature observability a signal soldier can act on)
gaps.problem: Once C2/ISR software and ATR/CV models are fielded on tens to hundreds of tactical edge nodes, pushing updates across air-gapped or intermittently connected clusters, validating models against the local sensor/environment, tracking which version runs where, rolling back safely and proving it for the authorization boundary is still manual and unsupported by tooling that assumes reachback.
gaps.user: Signal/G6 platform teams at brigade to corps, PM C2 Infrastructure field support, brigade/division S2 sections running Frontline-class ATR, software-factory SREs supporting fielded units, program-office ISSMs owning the edge ATO boundary, program AI leads (PM IS&A Linchpin, CDAO)
